turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty. The matter you seek to resolve is indeed of great importance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall reveal myself fully, then. My name is Leopold, King of Bohemia, and I have come to you, Mr. Holmes, with a matter of the utmost urgency and sensitivity.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I suspected as much. Kindly proceed with your request.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, please rest assured that Mr. Holmes and I are here to assist you in any way we can.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Mr. Holmes, I shall entrust you with this delicate matter. It pertains to a most personal issue that could have grave political ramifications for my realm.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I understand the gravity of your situation and assure you that Mr. Holmes will approach this matter with the utmost discretion.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am deeply grateful for your assurances, gentlemen. Now, let us proceed to the heart of the matter, as time is of the essence.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty, Mr. Holmes and I are ready to hear your request.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: As you know, the issue at hand involves my estranged wife, whose actions threaten not only my personal happiness but also the stability of my kingdom. I must act with utmost caution.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am here to support Mr. Holmes in any way necessary, Your Majesty. Please, continue with the details of your request.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall provide you with all the necessary details, but I must emphasize the utmost secrecy. My wife's recent actions have put me in a precarious position, and I cannot risk any information falling into the wrong hands.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I appreciate your candor, Your Majesty. Please proceed with the specifics of your request.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am aware of the gravity of the situation, and I am fully prepared to pay any price to reclaim what is rightfully mine and to secure the future of my kingdom. Now, let us delve into the particulars.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I require a detailed account of the events that have led to this impasse. Begin with the circumstances surrounding your estrangement from your wife.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall recount the tale, but I implore you to maintain the utmost confidentiality. My wife, whom I once trusted implicitly, has now become a source of great distress and potential peril for our nation. She has taken an object of immense personal and political significance, and I fear it may be used against me and our kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I understand the urgency of your situation, Your Majesty. Please elaborate on the nature of the object your wife has taken and its significance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The object in question is a locket containing a portrait of my wife as a young woman, a gift from a man who was once her suitor and a rival of mine. This locket has been the subject of a long-standing dispute, and its possession has now shifted the balance of power within my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty. Dr. Holmes will require all the facts to proceed with the case. Please continue with your account.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, Doctor Watson, I shall provide every detail. The portrait within the locket is not merely an image; it represents a past that could unravel the present stability of Bohemia. The man who gave it to my wife, Baron Adelbert Grimsby, is now a shadowy figure with significant influence, and the return of this locket to me is crucial to our security.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I appreciate your candor, Your Majesty. The portrait's return is indeed a matter of national importance. Let us proceed to the details of how and when the locket was taken, and any potential witnesses or clues.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
